title: Genlib authored module manifest
description: The authoring form for modules/<id>/module.json. Generated registry integrity records do not belong in this file.
$comment: Keep this authoring schema aligned with lib/catalog.mjs and docs/module-format.md. The CLI additionally checks source.path against id, the containing module directory, case-insensitive target uniqueness, export-to-file references, exact dependency availability and cycles, path conflicts, file sizes, filesystem types, and content integrity. JSON Schema validation cannot replace registry:check or an installation plan.

$schema.description: Optional editor reference to this authoring schema.

path.description: Must be modules/ followed by this module's exact id; the registry builder checks that relationship.

frameworks.description: Initial modules use react or any for framework-neutral code. Declaring a framework is not evidence of compatibility with a consuming application.

platform.description: Execution platform, such as web or server; read the module contract for runtime requirements.

reactMajors.description: Required when frameworks contains react. Framework-neutral modules omit this property.

dependencies.description: Exact local registry module dependencies; these are not npm package declarations.

files.description: Nonempty regular source files. The builder calculates hashes and byte counts; authors do not provide generated path, sha256, or bytes fields.

source.description: Path beneath this module's files directory.

target.description: File path relative to the installation output directory, normally src/genlib.

from.description: Must reference a files[].target path. The registry builder checks this relationship.

level.description: Use tested only after meaningful repository behavior tests pass; consumers still verify their integrated application.

testFiles.description: Existing test files relative to the repository root.

moduleVersion.description: An exact numeric major.minor.patch version; no ranges, tags, or prerelease labels.

relativePath.description: A portable forward-slash relative path. The CLI separately verifies filesystem safety, including symlinks, hard links, existing files, and containment.
